channel.title: mirageglobe
channel.description: Thoughts on software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and building for the long run.

item.title: Scout: Building for the Terminal in an Agentic World
item.description: Why I moved back to the terminal for daily work, and what building Scout taught me about designing tools for both humans and AI agents.
item.author: Jimmy MG Lim

item.title: Simple Clear Technology: Lessons Learned Over the Years
item.description: Reflections on why stable builds, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and relentless simplicity are the bedrock of resilient software.
item.author: Jimmy MG Lim

item.title: My Journey Across Clouds: Lessons from an AWS to GCP Migration
item.description: A personal retrospective on migrating infrastructure and services from AWS to GCP at a previous role, focusing on strategic planning, stakeholder alignment, and fostering organizational adoption.
item.author: Jimmy MG Lim

item.title: Why Job Sites Are Disappearing?
item.description: Job boards were already losing ground to social media and direct hiring. AI has since accelerated that on both sides of the hiring desk.
item.author: Jimmy MG Lim

item.title: Apprentice, Journeyman, and Master
item.description: The medieval guild's three-stage career path maps onto software engineering better than most modern career ladders do.
item.author: Jimmy MG Lim

item.title: What a Website Really Costs in the Age of AI
item.description: AI has made building a small website cheap. It has not made owning one cheap, and the pitfalls have moved from the build to what comes after.
item.author: Jimmy MG Lim
